1: The Moon is close to your own today. Feelings are near the surface; go with what feels right, but don't rush big calls.
A personal day: your mood sets the tone. Do one thing just for yourself.
2: Steady, practical energy. Good for budgets, bills and family talk; better for finishing than starting.
Today favours money matters and kind words. Say the honest thing, gently.
3: A brave, chatty day. Make the call, send the message, take the short trip.
Energy is up and words come easily. Good for asking for what you need.
4: You may want home and quiet today. Keep plans light and look after your peace of mind.
Feelings run toward home and family. A slower day is a better day.
5: A bright, creative day. Good for study, play and time with children or someone you love.
Your mind is quick and warm today. Learn something, or make something.
6: A good day to clear the pile: tasks, small problems, health routines. You'll get through more than you expect.
Practical energy for chores and fixing things. Small wins add up.
7: People come first today. Good for meetings, partnership and an honest talk with someone close.
A sociable day. Agreements and shared plans go well.
8: Energy may feel low or unsettled today. Keep things simple, avoid big risks and rest early.
A day to go gently. Don't sign or start anything big; tidy, rest and reflect.
9: A lucky, hopeful day. Good for learning, prayer and advice from elders.
Faith and good advice come easily today. Ask a teacher or an older friend.
10: A strong day for work. You're noticed; put your best effort where it counts.
Good for career moves, presentations and taking charge.
11: Things go your way more easily today. Good for friends, gains and finishing something you've waited on.
A rewarding day: what you've worked for may arrive.
12: A quiet, inward day. Spend less, rest more, and let go of what you can't control.
Low on outward push today. Good for rest, prayer and planning.
